items.name: Composite report
items.note: Annual gross, net and benchmark returns through 2025-12-31 [S1]

after.title: Key judgment — return history is present
after.text: The report presents annual gross, net and benchmark returns for the required periods [S1]. This three-series history supports performance comparison, while completeness still depends on the accompanying disclosures, calculation basis and any period-specific qualifications in the reviewed report.

after.title: Key judgment — composite identity is clear
after.text: The disclosure schedule identifies the fictional composite and its mandate [S2]. That pairing anchors the presented results to a named strategy, although identity alone does not resolve whether every account assignment and historical definition remained consistent.

after.title: Key judgment — event timing is absent
after.text: The report names one significant event without the effective date needed to place it in the record [S1]. Readers therefore cannot align the event with reported returns, and dated evidence is required before assessing its period-specific relevance.

after.title: Key judgment — fee text is incomplete
after.text: The disclosure schedule does not clearly state whether a performance fee applies [S2]. That omission limits net-return interpretation because readers cannot determine whether the reported result reflects every applicable fee or compare the basis consistently.

items.title: Event date absent
items.detail: The report does not date the significant event [S1].

items.title: Fee wording incomplete
items.detail: The schedule does not clearly state the performance fee [S2].

items.title: Approval evidence not supplied
items.detail: The supplied schedule does not include preparer approval evidence [S2].

after.title: Analysis — event context is incomplete
after.text: **Observation:** One significant event lacks an effective date [S1]. **Why it matters:** Readers cannot align the event with reported returns. **Uncertainty:** The date may exist outside the supplied report. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 1 producing dated event evidence.

after.title: Analysis — fee interpretation remains open
after.text: **Observation:** One performance-fee term remains unclear in the disclosure schedule [S2]. **Why it matters:** Net-return disclosures require an explicit and complete fee basis. **Uncertainty:** The approved fee schedule was not supplied. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 2 producing the approved schedule.

before.title: Disclosure readiness by report area
